text: Strongbox: a member that keeps your resources from being stolen at round end, for players whose whole plan is sitting on a pile.
Pawnbroker: Round End, before scoring, you may turn any of your resources into followers one for one, so a hoarder can still cash out after the thieves strike.
Green Regulars-style space, Loiterers: +1 follower per rival who has no minion on Green spaces, rewarding whoever spots the empty contest first.
Late Bloomer: a member that is cheaper for each member you lack compared to the rival with the most members, so a player who fell behind on members can catch up.
Sanctuary (member): once per round, when a rival would take one of your members, you may discard a resource of that member's colour to keep it.
Lookout (wheel space, Magenta): +2 magenta, and until round end the first steal against you this round takes nothing.
Census (member): Game End, +1 follower per member colour you have that no rival has.
Vault: a magenta member whose resources can't be stolen at round end, for players chasing the resource contest.
Lookout: a wheel space that lets you claim one open space for your next minion this round, so a planned combo can't silently vanish.
Hoarders: a magenta member that pays followers at round end for each resource you still hold, so holding feels as good as cashing in.
Bouncers: a member that makes your members immune to being taken by rivals' On Use abilities, as a defensive counterpart to Loyalists' swap protection.

Recount: a wheel space that shows each rival's member count and colour count and lets you change one of your own members' counts by one for the round, as a way to play around counting conditions on purpose.
Archivist: a member that pays followers whenever a member you once owned is used by a rival, so losing an engine card isn't total loss.
Clean Slate (white space): discard one of your members that a rival gave you this round, and gain white equal to its cost.
Lockbox (grey member): once per round, protect one of your resource piles from steals until your next turn.
Last Word (purple space): if a rival holds the Goes Last token, place your next minion immediately after their final one.
Rainmaker (silver member): Round End, after contests, give away any silver you hold for +1 follower each, so the silver engine and the Fewest Silver contest stop fighting.
Last Word (purple space): the next player to take the Goes Last token after you gives you +2 purple, so losing the token stings them a little too.
Collector's Guild (blue member): Round End, +1 follower per member you have beyond the fewest at the table, a payoff for going wide against minimalist decks.
Landlord (Silver member): whenever a rival gives you silver, you may pass that much on to a different rival.
Crowd Pleaser (White space): the player with the fewest members gives one resource of their choice to each rival.
Reserve Stock (Blue space): set aside one discard-pile member; only you may recruit it next round.
Housewarming (grey member): whenever a rival gives you a member, +2 followers.
Ascetics (white member): counts as 0 members for White's contest only, so a lean player can own one body without breaking the curse dance.
Hand-Me-Down (white space): give one of your members to the rival with the fewest members and gain followers equal to how many members they now have.
Pack Rat (grey member): once per round, your follower buy may also include one extra 1-pack, to break the single-pack autopilot.
Stage Door (purple space): take the Goes Last token, and it can't be taken from you by a member's ability this round.
Heckler (grey member): once per game, cancel another player's round-end ability as it triggers, as an answer to Spoilsport-style vetoes.
Clearance Rack (Blue space): recruit the cheapest card in the discard pile and gain one follower per card discarded this round.
Grudge Holders (red member): whenever one of your members is swapped away, take back any rival member of equal or lower cost.
Fence (magenta-style guest): Round End, gain followers equal to the most resources any one rival holds of one colour, divided down.
Night Owls: a member that gives +1 of each color at round end if you placed the round's last minion, so going last feeds next round too.
Witness: a member that keeps one contest of your choice from being cancelled or spoiled this round.
Odd Jobs: a wheel space that turns each leftover resource you hold into 1 follower, for the very end of the game.
Crowd Control: a wheel space that adds 1 to your count in the members or green contest this round, so someone can challenge a runaway leader.
Small Change (wheel space): turn up to 4 of your leftover resources into followers without using your recruit, a crumb-sweeper for odd piles.
Watchers (member): Round End, if you didn't win any contest this round, +1 resource of each color for every rival who won two or more.
Turncoat Census (member): your members of one color count double in the Red contest but don't count in the Blue contest, so a body-pile has to choose a race.
Bodyguard: once per game, when a rival swaps or takes one of your members, cancel it.
Rainy Day Fund: resources you passed a recruit to save can't be stolen this round.
Grudge Holders: whenever a rival's swap or steal hits your cult, +3 of any color.
Ransom Note (Magenta space): name a rival's member; that rival either gives it to you or pays you its cost in resources, their choice.
Strongroom (magenta member): your magenta counts double in Most resources.
Census (White space): every player with fewer members than you takes a shop member of your choice for free.
Hostage Takers (magenta member): Round End, take a member of your choice from the rival with the most followers.
Vault Keepers: a member that, once per round, makes one of your members unstealable until round end.
Open Hand: a White space that pays followers per member you have, rewarding the wide player on the same color whose contest rewards going narrow.
Patron of the Arts: a Yellow member that pays at round end for each member you've held all round, so a stable tableau earns more than a churned one.
Tie-Breaker (member): Round End, when you share a contest lead, you may claim the full prize, but each rival you were tied with gains resources.
Recluse's Retreat (white center space): +1 follower per round you have stayed at 2 or fewer members, so a lean cult has a real payoff to chase.
Insurance Agents (member): whenever a rival takes one of your members, gain followers equal to its cost.
Tarnish (silver space): every player at 0 silver gains 1 silver, so a zero-tie can actually be broken.
Strongbox (member): resources you hold in one color you name can't be stolen.
Clean Slate (white space): if you hold no resources and no members, gain followers instead of resources.
Hush Money (silver space): give a rival silver from the bank, and they can't take a silver space this round.
Tithe (wheel space): gain 1 resource of your choice per member you have, so a wide cult can fund its own conversions.
Bouncers (member): once per round, when a rival takes one of your members, you may pay to keep it.
Census (member): Round End, if you won no contest, +1 follower per member you have.
Collection Plate (wheel space): every rival holding more resources than you gives you 1.
Lost and Found (blue space): recruit a member from the discard pile that was taken from you this game, for free.
Sanctuary (grey member): members can't leave your cult by steal, swap or kidnap while you have fewer members than the leader.
Bargain Bin (blue member): Round End, if the discard pile has 10 or more cards, +2 followers.
Getaway Driver: once per round, after a rival takes one of your members, steal 2 resources from them.
Hoarders: Round End, +1 follower per 3 of your largest single resource pile, so a thief has something to do with ballast besides plain 10-packs.
Silver Lining (silver space): turn any silver you hold into followers without using your recruit, so silver members have a way to cash out despite Fewest silver.
Last Rites: once per game, when one of your members is swapped or stolen away, recruit a discard-pile member costing up to that much.
Wallflowers: a member that counts as one extra member for each contest you lost last round.
Clean Hands: a silver space that pays followers equal to the silver you discard to the bank, so a gifter has a way to shed the cloak's silver.
Spinster: a member that, while you hold the fewest members, wins ties in contests you're tied for.
Charity Drive: a silver space that gives rivals silver and lets you take one member from whoever ends up holding the most silver.
Hecklers (purple member): whenever a rival takes a consecutive turn, you gain 1 purple, so the rest of the table gets something from a long solo chain.
Cut In (purple wheel space): your next minion is placed right after the next rival who takes two turns in a row.
Census Taker (yellow member): shows a live running total of every player's round-end follower payouts, so I'd have known Cal wasn't really 30 behind.
Night Shift: a purple member that pays you followers each time your Goes Last token gets taken from you, so losing the token still gives you something.
Lone Wolf: a member that pays followers at round end if all your members share one color, to give a focused plan a reason to stay focused.
Interruption: a purple wheel space that lets you place right now, in the middle of a rival's run of consecutive turns.
Interloper (purple member): Whenever a rival takes three or more turns in a row, you take one placement immediately after their run ends.
Patron (yellow member): Round End: if you won Most member colors, +1 yellow per color you lead the next player by.
Sound Check (green space): Copy the action a rival took most recently on a space whose color you have no members of, +1 green.
Closing Time (purple space, center): Your remaining minions are placed now, one after another, and you cannot take the Goes Last token this round.
Sanctuary (member): Round Start, choose one of your members; it can't be swapped or taken this round, a lighter Loyalists for a single key engine.
Tithe Box (wheel space): turn your leftover resources of every color into followers at half rate without using a recruit, so the final turn has something to weigh.
Crowded House (member): Round End, +followers if you lead a 'most' contest while having the most members, giving wide builds a way to pressure the Fewest members player.
Appeal (wheel space): Round End, you may restore one contest a Spoilsport cancelled, at a cost in followers.
Hermit, a white member: whenever you are the only leader in Fewest members, it pays extra followers, giving a lean cult a reason to protect sole leadership rather than just hold a tie.
Audit, a White wheel space: pick a rival's contest lead and make them pay white or resources to keep it, a way for a resource-lean lane to pressure member-heavy leads.
Recluse, a grey member: it counts as 0 members for Fewest members but still triggers your cloak, a lean-lane engine that doesn't break the plan it supports.
Last Rites, a center White space: discard your last member for followers equal to the contests it helped you win, giving the final turn a real choice instead of another pack.
Return to Sender: whenever a rival gives you a member, you may give it straight back to them.
Big Household: Round End: +1 follower per member you have beyond the fewest held by any player.
Family Reunion: a red wheel space that gives +1 follower per member in your biggest one-color group.
Underdog: Round Start: if you have the fewest followers, +1 resource of each color.
Bystander: Round End, if a rival leads a contest you have no stake in, +3 followers, so a member-line player has some answer to an uncontested Green camp.
Bootleg: a green member that, once per round, lets you copy an action even through Agents, but the rival whose action you copied gains what you gained.
Encore Night: a center green space that repeats your own last placement this round, but only its printed resources, with no member bonuses.
Closing Time: a grey member that, at Round End, lets every player in reverse turn order use one unused On Use ability, so the last placement isn't automatically unanswerable.
Bouncers: your members can't be swapped, taken or discarded by rivals.
Heckler: whenever a rival copies an action, you gain +1 follower.
Clearance Bin (Blue space): recruit from the discard pile, or from the top of the pile if the discard pile is empty.
